newsitem.title: USA: Perkin in SmithKline research pact.
newsitem.headline: Perkin in SmithKline research pact.

text.p: The Perkin-Elmer Corp said on Friday it signed a research pact with SmithKline Beecham Plc.
The collaboration is to develop automated data management and analysis systems that will speed the drug discovery process for the pharmaceutical industry, Perkin-Elmer said.
Under the terms of the agreement, SmithKline Beecham will receive access to analysis and development tools for Perkin-Elmer's ABI PRISM BioLIMS laboratory infon management system, Perkin-Elmer said.
SmithKline Beecham will provide development support for the BioLIMS and will aid in developing functional specifications for future products.
Perkin-Elmer said that as a result of the pact it hopes to develop systems for data collection, analysis, and management that it can market to the pharmaceutical industry.
